## Services — Detailed Descriptions

### 1. Airport Chauffeur Transfers
URL: https://www.elitecarsaustralia.com.au/services/airport-transfers

Door-to-door luxury airport transfers with live commercial flight tracking and terminal meet-and-greet service. Your professional chauffeur monitors your flight in real time, waits inside arrivals with an executive digital name sign, and assists with all luggage. Available at every major Australian airport terminal including international, domestic, and private aviation terminals. Child seats and booster seats available upon request.

### 2. Corporate Accounts & Executive Assistant Support
URL: https://www.elitecarsaustralia.com.au/services/corporate-accounts

Centralized 30-day corporate billing with consolidated itemized tax invoices, cost-center coding, EA priority dispatch bookings, and multi-city management for executive teams. Streamlined onboarding for companies of all sizes.

### 3. As-Directed Hourly Chauffeur Hire
URL: https://www.elitecarsaustralia.com.au/services/as-directed-chauffeur-hire

Flexible luxury vehicle and private chauffeur on standby for multi-stop meetings, VIP schedules, city tours, and any itinerary requiring on-demand mobility. Minimum booking applies.

### 4. Executive Roadshows
URL: https://www.elitecarsaustralia.com.au/services/roadshows

Precision multi-stop travel coordination and luxury fleet deployment for investor roadshows, board meetings, IPO roadshows, and multi-day corporate itineraries across Australian cities.

### 5. Conferences & VIP Event Transport
URL: https://www.elitecarsaustralia.com.au/services/events

Coordinated luxury group transport and VIP delegate logistics for conventions, summits, conferences, private galas, sporting events, and high-profile corporate functions. Multi-vehicle dispatch coordination included.

### 6. Luxury Wedding Car Hire
URL: https://www.elitecarsaustralia.com.au/services/weddings

Immaculate Mercedes-Benz, Maybach, and BMW bridal cars with suited professional chauffeurs. Wedding packages include bridal party transport, groomsmen vehicles, guest shuttles, and venue-to-venue coordination.

### 7. Private Aviation & FBO Tarmac Transfers
URL: https://www.elitecarsaustralia.com.au/services/private-aviation-fbo

Direct tarmac and private jet FBO terminal chauffeured transfers with aircraft tail tracking and VIP security protocols. Services all FBO facilities including ExecuJet Sydney, Jet Aviation Sydney, Essendon Fields Melbourne, Tullamarine FBO, and Brisbane Airport FBO. ASIC-accredited drivers available for airside tarmac access.

### 8. Interstate & Regional Chauffeur Transfers
URL: https://www.elitecarsaustralia.com.au/services/interstate-transfers

Comfortable, private long-distance chauffeured journeys between capital cities and regional commercial hubs. Popular routes include Sydney–Canberra, Sydney–Newcastle, Melbourne–Geelong, Brisbane–Gold Coast, and more.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I book a luxury chauffeur or request a quote?
You can book directly or request a quotation online at https://www.elitecarsaustralia.com.au/#booking, call the 24/7 concierge at +61 430 729 993, or message directly via WhatsApp. Instant reservation confirmation and transparent pricing provided.

### Which Australian cities and airports does Elite Cars Australia service?
Nationwide coverage: Sydney (SYD & Western Sydney International), Melbourne (Tullamarine MEL & Essendon), Brisbane (BNE), Perth (PER), Adelaide (ADL), Gold Coast (OOL), Canberra (CBR), Hobart (HBA), Darwin (DRW), and all interstate routes.

### What luxury vehicles are available?
Mercedes-Benz S-Class, Mercedes Maybach, BMW 7 Series, Audi Q7, BMW X7, Mercedes-Benz GLS, Mercedes-Benz V-Class (7 passengers), and Mercedes Sprinter (14 passengers).

### Do you track flights for airport transfers?
Yes. Dispatch monitors real-time commercial and private aviation flight radar. Even if delayed or early, your chauffeur will be positioned inside arrivals with an executive name tablet.

### Do you provide corporate billing and monthly invoices?
Yes. Streamlined corporate accounts with 30-day billing, consolidated itemized tax invoices with cost-center coding, EA priority dispatch, and multi-city management.

### How does the meet-and-greet work at airports?
Your chauffeur waits inside the terminal at the arrival baggage carousel exit with an executive digital name sign. You receive the chauffeur's name, phone number, and vehicle registration before landing.

### Can you provide child seats?
Yes. Certified Australian Standard rear-facing, forward-facing child seats and booster seats installed prior to arrival upon request.

### Do you service private jet FBO facilities?
Yes. All private jet FBO hangars across Australia including Jet Aviation and ExecuJet at Sydney Airport, Essendon Fields and Tullamarine FBO in Melbourne, and Brisbane Airport FBO. ASIC-accredited drivers available tarmac-side.
